title: Run ledger event
description: One line of _data/runs.jsonl. The run ledger is an append-only event log, the idea log's own pattern applied to orchestrator runs (PLAN-039.01 section 5): a line is an event that happened, and nothing is ever edited or removed. `attempts` and `budget` are folds over this file rather than fields in graph state, which is what makes the checkpoint store disposable (ADR-018) -- deleting it loses nothing this file cannot reconstruct (REQ-022 R18).

run_id.description: Identifies one run for its whole life. Assigned by tools/append_run.py's `start` command and carried by every later event about the same run.

kind.description: Which of the four run kinds this event belongs to (PLAN-039.01 section 1).

event.description: started=a run was opened under a natural key | position=the run's thread reached a named node | dispatched=an agent was invoked with a budget cap | dispatch_result=the dispatch's outcome and reported usage | gate_reached=an interrupt() was hit | gate_decided=an owner decision resumed a gate | parked=the run is waiting on something other than a gate (for example a budget cap) | abandoned=the run's thread was abandoned and re-keyed, or the run was ended without completing | terminal=the run reached its end state

at.description: When the event happened, RFC 3339 with a mandatory offset. Generated by the writer from the real clock, matching idea.schema.json's rule against a supplied timestamp.

eid.description: Explicit event identity, generated by the writer for every appended event. Not currently amended by anything in this phase's scope; carried for the same reconstruction guarantee idea.schema.json documents.

natural_key.description: `(kind, primary ref)` as a string, for example `intake:000123` or `unit:phase-irs-04`. Required on `started` -- reconcile consults the ledger for a non-terminal run under this key before starting one, which is what makes run starts idempotent (PLAN-039.01 section 4).

refs.description: The run's references into repository records at the moment it started -- idea ids, document codes, phase id, branch name, track key. Mirrors the graph state's own `refs` field (ADR-018's thin-state rule); required on `started`.

position.description: The node or stage name the run's thread reached. Required on `position`, `gate_reached` and `terminal`.

role.description: The role contract dispatched (phase-irs-03). Required on `dispatched`.

budget_cap.description: The per-dispatch token ceiling in force for this dispatch (PLAN-039.01 section 8). Required on `dispatched`.

usage.description: Tokens the SDK reported for the dispatch, the authoritative spend counter (REQ-022 R20). Required on `dispatch_result`.

outcome.description: A short outcome label. Required on `dispatch_result` (for example `ok`, `error`) and on `terminal` (for example `complete`, `rejected`, `budget_exceeded`).

gate.description: The gate's name (for example `G2`, `dispatch-authorization`). Required on `gate_reached` and `gate_decided`.

decision.description: The owner's verb, mirrored from the gate-decision event that resumed this gate (PLAN-039.01 section 7). Required on `gate_decided`.

reason.description: Why the run parked or was abandoned. Required on `parked` and `abandoned`.
